title: Tracy CI on a pull request into develop: without ci:e2e no browser starts (the EmDash rows follow the label, the two design-inspiration browser tests live under test/e2e), and release pull requests, the nightly and manual runs are unchanged
steps: S1: From an installed TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap scripts/test/ci-plan.test.mjs scripts/test/ci-test-scope.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the '# pass' and '# fail' lines and the result of each test named in run.tests.
expect: A pull request into develop that touches an EmDash theme and carries no ci:e2e label has no tests emdash-* row; the row is recorded in leftOut with label ci:e2e and wouldRun true, the scope is partial:db+e2e, and the notice names the label.
The same pull request with ci:e2e gets only the row of the theme it touched; with unreadable labels it keeps the row and leaves nothing out.
Pull requests into main and staging, workflow_dispatch and schedule run every EmDash row and the e2e row, labels or no labels, and leave nothing out.
A change that touches no theme records no EmDash row as left out.
fence: A pull request into develop starts a browser only when it carries the label ci:e2e; every other event still runs every row.

tests: without ci:e2e a pull request into develop that touches a theme gets no EmDash row
with ci:e2e the EmDash row of the touched theme runs, and only that one
a theme that is not touched leaves no trace in leftOut: nothing was lost
an EmDash theme PR with unreadable labels keeps the row: nothing is opted out
release pull requests, the nightly and manual runs still run every EmDash row without a label
the opt-in applies when the planner would have run every row, except for the unreadable cases
